author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a hooked blob beside a tag with a dot and read as a price tag or a bent pipe; there was no clear fire. Redrawn after the reference: a banknote tilted 45 degrees running from the top-right corner into a big upright flame at the lower left. The flame has a tall tip, a round base and a second tongue licking up the note, and the note's sides disappear into it.
omissions: The note's round coin mark and the small inner flame were dropped: the visible part of the note is too short for a mark 8 from every edge, and an inner lick rendered as a blob.
